origin: Codex research directed by repository owner

claims.statement: Equations (1)-(3) give all Koszul ranks of convolutions, in all leg orientations and with a padded shared space, over C.
claims.limitations: Standard constructions rederived here; no historical priority claim. Not a complete degeneration criterion.

claims.statement: k copies of C(a,b) sharing their full output space with arbitrary invertible identifications and disjoint input spaces have rank and border rank k(a+b-1).
claims.limitations: Does not assert border-rank additivity for arbitrary shared-leg sums.

claims.statement: All 85 specific candidate packings in the archived dimension search violate a Koszul-rank inequality; 180 oriented and 27 padded direct matrix checks agree with the formulas.
claims.limitations: Alternative packings are not exhausted. The general rank formulas rely on the written proofs.

claims.statement: The canonical mixed family passes all full-space Koszul tests on all three legs for every k>=1; its P_* score surplus is (4k-210)/81.
claims.limitations: Source degeneration unconstructed; projected and other Young flattenings not covered; no exponent implication established.

claims.statement: The canonical four-block target T has border rank 10 via ten-point triangular-grid interpolation; T tensor B_X(k) has border rank 10k.
claims.limitations: Certificate starts from a diagonal tensor, not from C(4,10k); no priority claim for the interpolation construction.

claims.statement: Coordinate selection, rescaling and diagonal weights realizing the four-type target from C(4,B) require B>=12k-1.
claims.limitations: Arbitrary linear changes of basis are excluded from this obstruction.

claims.statement: For every actual tensor character at t=3/4, the rescaled symmetrized convolution profile has the forced homogeneous form, without a C1 assumption.
dependencies: UZ26 v2 Lemma 4.1 and Appendix F
claims.limitations: Does not construct or exclude a critical character. External rescaling theorem is imported, not re-formalized.

claims.statement: A uniform positive normalized curvature delta0 for actual characters with t>=t0<3/4 implies omega<=max(3t0,9/(4(1+delta0))).
claims.limitations: The positive curvature premise remains unproved.

claims.statement: Massarenti-Raviolo Remark 3.3 excludes exact-rank schemes beating 9/4 at n=34..37; at n=38 only rank 3585 survives the two bounds used.
claims.limitations: External exact-rank premise; not a border-rank bound or an exhaustive literature frontier.
